morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接数量词表示若干个该数量单位；bilion 的首辅音 b 保留，不发生鼻音替换。音标采用元音分读形式，连读可更紧凑。

word_family.gloss: 十亿；旧式长级差用法另有所指

senses.zh_definition: 数十亿的；以十亿计的，表示若干个十亿或非常庞大的数量，不指定确切数值。
senses.en_definition: Amounting to several billion; numbering in the billions.
senses.nuances: 实际语法类别是 kata bilangan tak tentu（不定数词）；受给定词性枚举限制，pos 暂映射为 adjective。现代数量表达通常以 satu bilion = 1,000,000,000 理解，中文为“十亿”，不可误译为“一亿”。DBP 较早释义还记录 10¹² 的旧英国用法，阅读历史文献应核对计数体系。berbilion-bilion 是常见重叠形式。[DBP：bilion 与 berbilion](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bilion)；[DBP：数学术语中的 bilion](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=bilion)

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 职场项目汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Projek infrastruktur itu dijangka menelan belanja berbilion ringgit sepanjang tempoh pelaksanaannya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该基础设施项目在整个实施期间预计耗资数十亿令吉。
dual_scenarios.en: The infrastructure project is expected to cost billions of ringgit over its implementation period.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Projek tu makan belanja berbilion ringgit, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Projek itu menelan belanja berbilion ringgit, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个项目要花数十亿令吉，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: That project costs billions of ringgit, right?
spoken_features: makan belanja 是较口语化的耗资表达

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku baru baca berita ni. Projek tu makan belanja berbilion ringgit, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Saya baru membaca berita ini. Projek itu menelan belanja berbilion ringgit, bukan?
messages.zh: 我刚看到这条新闻。那个项目要花数十亿令吉，对吧？
messages.en: I just read this story. That project costs billions of ringgit, right?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, tapi aku nak semak angka sebenar dulu. Tajuk berita tu ringkas je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, tetapi saya mahu menyemak angka sebenar terlebih dahulu. Tajuk berita itu hanya memberikan maklumat ringkas.
messages.zh: 对，不过我想先查一下具体数字，标题写得很简略。
messages.en: Yes, but I want to check the actual figure first. The headline doesn't give much detail.

etymology.historical_story: Berbilion shows how Malay builds an indefinite quantity from a numerical base: ber- combines with bilion to express billions. DBP also records berbilion-bilion. Its dictionary material preserves the older contrast between billion as a million million and as a thousand million, explaining why historical figures sometimes require careful interpretation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bilion)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bilion 是“十亿”；加 ber- 就想到“一批批十亿”，即数十亿。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 该词本身语域中性，适合新闻、商务与日常讨论；汇报预算时附上币种、时间范围及确切数字会更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 口语可用来强调规模庞大；正式报告中，已知具体金额时宜直接写明，例如 RM3 bilion，避免让概数量词承担精确数值的功能。
